record:
Account summary (partner-led):
- KiteBridge is a cloud services / marketplace reseller building a managed “LLM features” package for mid-market SaaS and a subset of regulated customers (fintech + healthcare). They want Redwood as the inference backbone and are pushing for a joint GTM motion (co-marketing + marketplace listing).

Partner motion & co-marketing notes:
- Primary ask: co-branded assets leveraging our new “production economics” benchmark report (latency per dollar) as a credibility anchor.
- They specifically want: (1) a co-branded slide they can use in marketplace listing + sales deck, (2) a short email blurb for their newsletter, and (3) a shared webinar concept (their audience: platform teams).
- We pointed them to the partner co-marketing kit (Drive) and set expectations: use approved blurbs only; no absolute superiority claims; must include methodology/disclaimer language.

Marketplace listing interest:
- They are deciding between referral vs reseller. Asked: “Can we sell Dedicated capacity as part of our managed service?” and “Do you support private/VPC options we can scope for regulated customers?”
- Requested a checklist: region availability, how routing/fallback works across regions, and how to position data residency for EU buyers.

Use cases discussed:
- Doc-search + summarization for customer support portals (embeddings + chat).
- “Support-agent” style workflow (tool calling + structured output) for internal ops teams.

Technical + commercial requirements (from discovery/demo):
- Regions: EU is non-negotiable; also APAC presence for a subset of their customers (they said 20–30% of their user base is APAC-heavy).
- Latency/throughput: they care more about p95 and consistency under concurrency than headline p50. Want a clear story on variance and rerun methodology (they’ve been burned by benchmark one-offs).
- Cost: they want a predictable way to estimate unit economics for their bundle (cost per 1M tokens; how caching/batching impacts spend; what levers exist).
- Security: expect SOC 2, audit logs, SSO/SAML for console access, retention controls, KMS story, and a clean statement on what benchmark data includes (no customer data exposure).

Open questions:
- What’s the approved co-brandable “headline” from the benchmark report? They asked for a single sentence and one chart. Need to route through Marketing + Legal review before they publish anything.
- Support model: KiteBridge wants us to handle Tier-3 performance investigations; they handle Tier-1. Need to define escalation path + SLAs.

Internal guidance / reminders for anyone touching this account:
- Keep benchmark claims consistent with public benchmarking claims guidelines; always offer to walk through methodology + confidence/variance language.
- If they reference the launch-week website hiccup (INT-1192), keep it factual: issue was a download link/caching problem on the landing page, resolved same day; no impact to API performance.
